force_evaluate.name: Force evaluate
force_evaluate.description: Run an immediate evaluation; safety gates and execution policy are not bypassed.

set_mode.name: Set mode
set_mode.description: Auto permits guarded physical shedding; Observe evaluates and records intended actions without physical services; Off disables normal shedding. Off and Observe never call physical services, including emergency paths.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Auto may issue guarded physical OFF commands. Observe evaluates and audits only. Off disarms normal policy decisions.

request_stop.name: Request logical-device stop
request_stop.description: Guarded stop request through the integration; do not call a raw relay service.

device_id.name: Logical device ID
device_id.description: Stable device_id, not a raw switch entity ID.

clear_quarantine.name: Clear device quarantine
clear_quarantine.description: Clear a persisted quarantine only after verified available OFF state, valid aggregate telemetry, and safe measured power.

device_id.name: Logical device ID
device_id.description: Stable logical device_id, not a raw entity ID.

source.name: Clear source
source.description: Audit label for the explicit operator request.

user.title: Safety Inputs
user.description:
Select the load and safety inputs for bounded load shedding:
{summary}

data_description.grid_power: Optional grid/import power sensor used only as a safety and diagnostic input. The load sensor below is authoritative for shedding decisions.
data_description.battery_soc: Battery state-of-charge sensor used by threshold safety mode and availability checks. An unavailable, unknown, or wrong-unit value blocks planner actions and can trigger the safety stop.

load_monitoring.title: Load Monitoring
load_monitoring.description: Monitor total load using {sensor_name}. If the average load exceeds the limit, optional devices will be turned off.

data_description.load_sensor: Authoritative whole-house power sensor. Available, non-negative readings in watts drive shedding decisions; unavailable, unknown, or unsupported-unit readings block planner actions.
data_description.averaging_period: Time window used to calculate average load. A longer window smooths short spikes; it does not change the source entity's semantic availability.

thresholds.title: Load Shedding Threshold
thresholds.description: Configure threshold step {index}. Already configured: {count}. Enable the next-step option to build a dynamic list.

data_description.threshold_power: The power limit must be greater than the previous threshold and must not exceed the safety interlock.
data_description.threshold_duration: How many seconds the available load must continuously remain above this threshold.
data_description.add_threshold: After saving this step, open another step; the list is not limited to ten fixed positions.

devices.title: Optional Devices
devices.description:
Select the logical loads to manage, remove any you do not want to shed, and optionally add a custom load. For each selected load, choose the on/off entity. Configured: {count}

Available: {discovered}

data.name: Friendly name (leave empty to keep the discovered name)
data.power_sensor: Power sensor (auto-discovered when available; choose another to override)
data.add_another: Add another custom device after this one

data_description.discovered_devices: Candidate logical loads only. Select candidates that map to real controllable entities; unselected candidates are ignored, and a measurement sensor is never toggled directly.
data_description.add_custom_device: If enabled, opens a control-mapping form after discovery so you can add a switch, light, or input_boolean manually.
data_description.entity: The actual on/off control entity that the integration may command. This is the physical service target and must be a switch, light, or input_boolean.
data_description.name: Friendly name shown in entities, priorities, notifications, and logs. Leave it empty to keep the discovered or Home Assistant name.
data_description.expected_power: Expected load in watts used to estimate the effect of shedding. It is planning telemetry only and never authorizes an activation.
data_description.power_sensor: Measured device-power sensor used for telemetry and readback. Available non-negative readings are never used to authorize an activation.
data_description.actuators: Optional additional entities in the same logical load group, such as a climate entity paired with a switch. Every actuator must provide causal readback; partial, unknown, or unavailable group state is fail-closed and cannot confirm ON or OFF.
data_description.add_another: Controls only the custom-device form loop. It has no runtime effect; enable it to configure another custom device before assigning priorities.

priority.title: Priority & Pause

data_description.priority_order: Drag the managed entities into the desired shedding order. The first item is shed first.
data_description.pause_period: Seconds a device remains paused after the coordinator turns it off, reducing rapid cycling before it becomes eligible again. Emergency safety stops still apply.

grid_loss.title: Grid Loss Behavior
grid_loss.description:
Choose how to detect grid loss. When grid is lost, all optional devices are turned off immediately.

{battery_info}

data_description.grid_loss_mode: Select the safety source. A valid, available source is required for ordinary shedding decisions.

grid_loss_source.title: Grid Loss Source
grid_loss_source.description: Choose the source for the selected mode.

data.grid_loss_sensor: Binary sensor: ON = grid available, OFF = grid lost

data_description.grid_loss_sensor: Used only in binary-sensor mode. It must be available and report ON for normal operation; OFF, unknown, unavailable, or missing input triggers an emergency stop of optional devices.
data_description.battery_soc: Used only in battery-threshold mode. It must be available and report a percent value; unavailable, unknown, or invalid input triggers the safety stop.
data_description.battery_threshold: Battery SoC percentage at or below which the system treats the safety source as lost.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Power Orchestrator
reconfigure.description: Update safety sources, thresholds, managed devices, and runtime limits without removing the integration.

data_description.load_sensor: Authoritative whole-house power sensor. Invalid, unavailable, unknown, or wrong-unit values block planner actions.
data_description.averaging_period: Average-load window; it does not change source-entity semantic availability. Unavailable or unknown input blocks normal planner actions.
data_description.pause_period: Seconds a shed device remains paused to prevent rapid repeated shedding.
data_description.grid_loss_mode: Select the authoritative grid-loss safety source.
data_description.grid_loss_sensor: Required in sensor mode; it must be available and ON for normal operation.
data_description.battery_soc: Required in battery-threshold mode; it must be available, valid, and above the threshold.
data_description.battery_threshold: SoC at or below which the safety source is considered lost and optional loads are shed.
data_description.devices: Complete logical-device mappings, including control entities, expected watts, actuator groups, and shedding priorities.

error.invalid_priority_order: Each priority position must contain a different optional device.
error.invalid_discovered_devices: Select only configured logical load candidates.
error.missing_grid_loss_sensor: Select a grid-loss binary sensor before continuing.
error.missing_battery_soc_sensor: Select a battery state-of-charge sensor before continuing.

abort.single_instance: Only one whole-house Power Orchestrator entry can be configured.

init.title: Runtime & Safety Options
init.description: Changing these options reloads the integration. Invalid or unavailable safety inputs fail closed.

data_description.load_sensor: Authoritative whole-house power sensor used for bounded shedding. Unavailable, unknown, invalid, or wrong-unit readings block planner actions.
data_description.averaging_period: Time window for average-load decisions. It does not extend the independent safety-input availability budget.
data_description.pause_period: Seconds a device remains paused after a shed stop. Emergency safety stops are not delayed by this timer.
data_description.grid_loss_mode: Select the authoritative safety source. Only a valid, available source permits ordinary shedding decisions.
data_description.grid_loss_sensor: Binary sensor used in sensor mode; it must be available and ON for normal operation. OFF, missing, unavailable, or unknown triggers safety shedding.
data_description.battery_soc: Percent sensor used in battery-threshold mode. It must be available, valid, and strictly above the configured threshold.
data_description.battery_threshold: SoC percentage at or below which the integration treats the safety source as lost and applies safety shedding.
data_description.devices: Structured mappings for every physical control: stable device_id, switch/light/input_boolean entity, expected watts, optional measured-power sensor, and unique priorities. Invalid mappings are rejected instead of silently skipped.
data_description.priority_order: The native reorderable list is the shedding order: the first entity is evaluated first.

thresholds.title: Overload threshold {index}
thresholds.description: Add thresholds in strictly increasing power order. Collected thresholds: {count}.

data_description.threshold_power: The available load must remain above this limit for the dwell time before one eligible load is stopped.
data_description.threshold_duration: Continuous seconds above the power limit. Invalid or unavailable telemetry never confirms shedding.
data_description.add_threshold: Continue with another strictly higher power limit.

error.invalid_priority_order: Each priority position must contain a different optional device.
error.missing_grid_loss_sensor: Select a grid-loss binary sensor before continuing.
error.missing_battery_soc_sensor: Select a battery state-of-charge sensor before continuing.
error.invalid_load_sensor: Select a valid sensor entity for whole-house load.
error.invalid_grid_loss_mode: Select a supported grid-loss safety mode.
error.invalid_grid_loss_sensor: Select a valid binary sensor for grid-loss detection.
error.invalid_battery_soc_sensor: Select a valid percent sensor for battery-threshold mode.
error.invalid_devices: Every device mapping must use a unique valid control entity, finite expected watts, optional sensor telemetry, and a unique positive priority.
error.invalid_numeric_setting: One or more numeric safety settings are outside the allowed finite range.

invalid_service_source.message: The request source must be a non-empty string.

invalid_service_mode.message: The mode must be auto, observe, or off.

entry_not_unique.message: Exactly one loaded Power Orchestrator entry is required.

missing_device_id.message: A logical device ID is required.

quarantine_requires_reconciliation.title: Power Orchestrator requires device reconciliation
quarantine_requires_reconciliation.description: Device {device_id} is quarantined because its last action could not be proven safe after a restart or failed readback.

reconfiguration_required.title: Power Orchestrator requires reconfiguration
reconfiguration_required.description: No user-derived overload threshold list could be migrated. Reconfigure the integration and provide at least one threshold before Auto mode can act.
